title: POV: The Doorbell Hasn't Even Finished Ringing And I'm Already There
description:
Zero to full alert in under one second. Every single time.

🧠 Understand the real behavior behind it: https://funnycutedogs.com/go/dogtraining

script: That sound. That specific sound. I was fully asleep four seconds ago and now I am at the door, at full volume, fully committed, before the bell has even finished its second ring. This is not optional. This is not something I can control. The second that sound happens, my entire body receives one instruction, and the instruction is go, loudly, immediately. You keep asking why I can't just stay calm. I keep asking why that sound exists if I'm not supposed to react to it. This response is actually deeply wired in, and there's a real, gentle way to teach a calmer door reaction without losing the part of me that's just doing my job. The link's below.
hookText: The doorbell rang. I am already there.
